description: Co-op input probe (gate G1). Observation only: no retail behaviour is changed.

_why: Added DOL sections are ignored on this game's disc boot path. Tested and
rejected: an added text slot, an added data slot, and a slot aliasing
existing in-file bytes. In all three the payload was absent from memory
while patched text1 bytes were resident, which proves text1 loads and
our edits to it take effect.
So the payload is written directly into text1, over TRK__write_aram and
TRK__read_aram. Those two are reachable only from TRKInterrupt, the
CodeWarrior debugger interrupt path, which does not run without a
hardware debugger attached. InitMetroTRK_BBA at 0x800C2E18 is
deliberately NOT included: __start calls it on every boot.
This keeps the patched DOL exactly the original size.
Base is 32-byte aligned because mwldeppc aligns .text; the first 20 bytes of TRK__write_aram are left intact.

hooks.name: poll_fn_800F7F64
hooks.note: stwu r1,-0x20(r1) at the per-pad poll boundary. Displaced instruction is re-executed by the trampoline, which then resumes at 0x800F7F68.

hooks.name: register_fn_800F80B0
hooks.note: lis r4, lbl_80401C10@ha at the pad allocator entry. Counts registration attempts per logical ID.
